beats.text: In the month of Chaitra, on the ninth day, Queen Kaushalya gave birth to Rama, the embodiment of dharma. Today that day is celebrated as Ram Navami.
Kaikeyi gave birth to Bharata. Sumitra gave birth to twins, Lakshmana and Shatrughna.
The four grew up inseparable. Lakshmana's heart belonged to Rama, and Shatrughna's to Bharata. Lakshmana would not even eat unless Rama was beside him.
Under Sage Vasishtha they mastered the Vedas, archery, riding elephants and chariots, and the duties of a righteous king.
Yet Rama was loved for more than his skill. Even as a boy he was kind to everyone, and he always spoke first, with a smile.
The old king looked at his four sons and felt that every one of his prayers had been answered. He did not know how soon the world would come asking for them.
